fc79abad04e2d6dd.g: A.P.'s room is east wing room 305 at the health resort on Shoreline. The Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P. is stuck into the laptop on the table. A.P.'s belongings in the form of TerraGroup corporate apartment key can be found on the right nightstand. The optional Fragment of an unknown document can be found on the left nightstand. The optional Guard post note to locate the room can be found on the first floor of the health resort west wing, on the desk next to the security room at the southern entrance.

d6f4fc06ee10f763.g: Craft the Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P. at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted.

82db974ad0531565.g: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the flash drive. He will say that he cannot help, but that Elektronik can if you hand over 5,000,000 Roubles.

f7276533dde844b7.g: You first have to craft the Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment lock (Green) at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. The blue and red ones are false leads. A.P.'s apartment is apartment 1 on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex on Streets of Tarkov. A TerraGroup corporate apartment key is required to enter it. Once inside the apartment, you have to go down the hallway to find the hidden room opened with the crafted keycard. In the room are 4 notes to pick up and read.
